# load qc output

```{r load-qc}
required_cols <- c(
  "sub_id", "space", "task", "acq", "run", "resolution",
  "dice_val", "dropout_compo", "nmi_t1_bold", "nmi_wt1_mni"
)

qc_metrics <- read_csv(params$qc_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)
missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(qc_metrics))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "qc csv is missing required columns: ",
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
    )
  )
}

if (!"ses_id" %in% names(qc_metrics)) {
  qc_metrics$ses_id <- NA_character_
}

available_spaces <- sort(unique(na.omit(qc_metrics$space)))
selected_space <- params$space

if (is.null(selected_space) || is.na(selected_space) || selected_space == "") {
  if (length(available_spaces) == 0) {
    stop("no output spaces found in qc csv")
  }
  if (length(available_spaces) > 1) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "multiple output spaces found: ",
        paste(available_spaces, collapse = ", "),
        "; set the space parameter before rendering"
      )
    )
  }
  selected_space <- available_spaces[[1]]
}

if (!selected_space %in% available_spaces) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "requested space not found: ", selected_space,
      "; available spaces: ", paste(available_spaces, collapse = ", ")
    )
  )
}

entity_token <- function(x, entity) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x) | x == ""] <- "none"
  x <- sub(paste0("^", entity, "-"), "", x)
  paste0(entity, "-", x)
}

qc_metrics <- qc_metrics |>
  filter(space == selected_space) |>
  mutate(
    code = paste(
      sub_id,
      entity_token(ses_id, "ses"),
      entity_token(task, "task"),
      entity_token(acq, "acq"),
      entity_token(run, "run"),
      entity_token(space, "space"),
      entity_token(resolution, "res"),
      sep = "_"
    )
  )

if (anyDuplicated(qc_metrics$code)) {
  stop("duplicate qc work items remain after space filtering")
}

metric_spec <- tribble(
  ~metric,          ~label,                                      ~direction,
  "dice_val",       "Dice index (anat/func masks)",             "low",
  "dropout_compo",  "Dropout score",                           "high",
  "nmi_t1_bold",    "T1w-BOLD normalized mutual information",  "low",
  "nmi_wt1_mni",    "warped T1-MNI normalized mutual information", "low"
) |>
  filter(map_lgl(metric, ~ sum(is.finite(qc_metrics[[.x]])) >= 2))

cat("selected space:", selected_space, "\n")
cat("work items:", nrow(qc_metrics), "\n")
cat("metrics:", paste(metric_spec$metric, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

# threshold methods

```{r threshold-functions}
extract_components_gmm <- function(gmm) {
  means <- as.numeric(gmm$means_)
  sds <- sqrt(as.numeric(gmm$covariances_))
  weights <- as.numeric(gmm$weights_)
  idx <- order(means)

  list(
    means = means[idx],
    sds = sds[idx],
    weights = weights[idx]
  )
}

compute_cutoff_gmm <- function(means, sds, weights) {
  if (length(means) < 2) return(numeric(0))

  sapply(seq_len(length(means) - 1), function(i) {
    optimize(
      function(cut) {
        abs(
          weights[i] * dnorm(cut, means[i], sds[i]) -
            weights[i + 1] * dnorm(cut, means[i + 1], sds[i + 1])
        )
      },
      interval = c(means[i], means[i + 1])
    )$minimum
  })
}

gmm2_threshold <- function(x) {
  tryCatch({
    x <- na.omit(x)
    if (length(x) < 2 || length(unique(x)) < 2) {
      return(list(cutoff = NA_real_, means = c(NA, NA), sds = c(NA, NA), weights = c(NA, NA)))
    }

    x_mat <- matrix(x, ncol = 1)
    gmm <- GaussianMixture(
      n_components = 2L,
      random_state = 42L,
      tol = 1e-5,
      max_iter = 300L,
      n_init = 5L,
      reg_covar = 1e-6
    )
    gmm$fit(x_mat)

    comp <- extract_components_gmm(gmm)
    cuts <- compute_cutoff_gmm(comp$means, comp$sds, comp$weights)

    list(
      cutoff = cuts[1],
      means = comp$means,
      sds = comp$sds,
      weights = comp$weights
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    list(cutoff = NA_real_, means = c(NA, NA), sds = c(NA, NA), weights = c(NA, NA))
  })
}

evt_threshold <- function(x, tail = c("high", "low"),
                          u_quantile = 0.90, alpha = 0.01, min_excess = 20L) {
  tail <- match.arg(tail)
  x <- na.omit(x)
  if (tail == "low") x <- -x

  u <- quantile(x, u_quantile)
  excess <- x[x > u] - u
  n_exc <- length(excess)

  if (n_exc < min_excess) return(NA_real_)

  tryCatch({
    fit <- sp$genpareto$fit(excess, floc = 0L)
    xi <- fit[[1]]
    sigma <- fit[[3]]
    rate <- n_exc / length(x)
    p <- 1 - alpha / rate

    if (!is.finite(xi) || sigma <= 0 || abs(xi) > 1 || p <= 0 || p >= 1) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    threshold <- if (abs(xi) < 1e-8) {
      u - sigma * log(1 - p)
    } else {
      u + sigma / xi * ((1 - p)^-xi - 1)
    }

    if (tail == "low") -threshold else threshold
  }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
}

threshold_row <- function(method, threshold, gmm = NULL) {
  if (is.null(gmm)) {
    tibble(
      method = method,
      threshold = threshold,
      GMM2_means = list(NA),
      GMM2_sds = list(NA),
      GMM2_weights = list(NA)
    )
  } else {
    tibble(
      method = method,
      threshold = threshold,
      GMM2_means = list(gmm$means),
      GMM2_sds = list(gmm$sds),
      GMM2_weights = list(gmm$weights)
    )
  }
}

compute_thresholds_high_bad <- function(
    x,
    percentiles = c(0.90, 0.95),
    sd_multiplier = c(2, 3),
    evt_alpha = c(0.01, 0.02)) {

  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) < 2) stop("at least two finite observations are required")

  rows <- list()

  for (p in percentiles) {
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- threshold_row(
      paste0("percentile_", p * 100, "th"),
      as.numeric(quantile(x, p))
    )
  }

  for (k in sd_multiplier) {
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- threshold_row(
      paste0("mean_", k, "sd"),
      mean(x) + k * sd(x)
    )
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- threshold_row(
      paste0("median_", k, "mad"),
      median(x) + k * mad(x)
    )
  }

  q <- quantile(x, c(0.25, 0.75))
  iqr <- q[2] - q[1]
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- threshold_row("IQR_x1.5", q[2] + 1.5 * iqr)
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- threshold_row("IQR_x3", q[2] + 3 * iqr)

  if (all(x > 0)) {
    lx <- log(x)
    ql <- quantile(lx, c(0.25, 0.75))
    iqrl <- ql[2] - ql[1]
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- threshold_row("IQR_x1.5_log", exp(ql[2] + 1.5 * iqrl))
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- threshold_row("IQR_x3_log", exp(ql[2] + 3 * iqrl))
  }

  adj <- adjboxStats(x)
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- threshold_row("adj_boxplot", adj$fence[2])

  for (a in evt_alpha) {
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- threshold_row(
      paste0("EVT_a", a),
      evt_threshold(x, tail = "high", alpha = a)
    )
  }

  gmm <- gmm2_threshold(x)
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- threshold_row("GMM2", gmm$cutoff, gmm)

  bind_rows(rows)
}

compute_thresholds_low_bad <- function(
    x,
    percentiles = c(0.10, 0.05),
    sd_multiplier = c(2, 3),
    evt_alpha = c(0.01, 0.02)) {

  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) < 2) stop("at least two finite observations are required")

  rows <- list()

  for (p in percentiles) {
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- threshold_row(
      paste0("percentile_", p * 100, "th"),
      as.numeric(quantile(x, p))
    )
  }

  for (k in sd_multiplier) {
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- threshold_row(
      paste0("mean_", k, "sd"),
      mean(x) - k * sd(x)
    )
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- threshold_row(
      paste0("median_", k, "mad"),
      median(x) - k * mad(x)
    )
  }

  q <- quantile(x, c(0.25, 0.75))
  iqr <- q[2] - q[1]
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- threshold_row("IQR_x1.5", q[1] - 1.5 * iqr)
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- threshold_row("IQR_x3", q[1] - 3 * iqr)

  if (all(x > 0)) {
    lx <- log(x)
    ql <- quantile(lx, c(0.25, 0.75))
    iqrl <- ql[2] - ql[1]
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- threshold_row("IQR_x1.5_log", exp(ql[1] - 1.5 * iqrl))
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- threshold_row("IQR_x3_log", exp(ql[1] - 3 * iqrl))
  }

  adj <- adjboxStats(x)
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- threshold_row("adj_boxplot", adj$fence[1])

  for (a in evt_alpha) {
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- threshold_row(
      paste0("EVT_a", a),
      evt_threshold(x, tail = "low", alpha = a)
    )
  }

  gmm <- gmm2_threshold(x)
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- threshold_row("GMM2", gmm$cutoff, gmm)

  bind_rows(rows)
}
```

# compute thresholds

```{r compute-thresholds}
threshold_results <- pmap_dfr(metric_spec, function(metric, label, direction) {
  x <- qc_metrics[[metric]]
  compute_fn <- if (direction == "low") compute_thresholds_low_bad else compute_thresholds_high_bad

  compute_fn(x) |>
    mutate(
      metric = metric,
      label = label,
      direction = direction,
      flags_n = map2_int(threshold, direction, function(cutoff, dir) {
        if (is.na(cutoff)) return(NA_integer_)
        if (dir == "low") sum(x < cutoff, na.rm = TRUE) else sum(x > cutoff, na.rm = TRUE)
      }),
      flags_pct = round(100 * flags_n / sum(!is.na(x)), 1),
      .before = 1
    )
})

threshold_results |>
  select(metric, label, direction, method, threshold, flags_n, flags_pct) |>
  write_csv(file.path(params$output_dir, "thresholds.csv"))

threshold_results |>
  select(metric, label, direction, method, threshold, flags_n, flags_pct)
```

# interactive explorer

```{r explorer-functions}
plot_thresholds_interactive <- function(
    dataset,
    metric,
    id_var,
    df_thresholds,
    direction = c("low", "high"),
    nbins = 80,
    metric_name = metric) {

  direction <- match.arg(direction)

  df <- dataset |>
    transmute(x = .data[[metric]], id = .data[[id_var]]) |>
    filter(is.finite(x))

  thr_valid <- df_thresholds |>
    filter(is.finite(threshold))

  if (nrow(df) == 0 || nrow(thr_valid) == 0) {
    stop(paste0("no usable values or thresholds for ", metric))
  }

  hist_plot <- ggplot(df, aes(x = x)) + geom_histogram(bins = nbins)
  hist_data <- ggplot_build(hist_plot)$data[[1]]

  global_breaks <- c(hist_data$xmin, tail(hist_data$xmax, 1))
  global_mids <- hist_data$x
  global_counts <- hist_data$count
  global_widths <- diff(global_breaks)
  max_global <- max(global_counts)
  method_colors <- grDevices::hcl.colors(nrow(thr_valid), palette = "Dark 3")

  is_gmm_valid <- function(i) {
    grepl("GMM", thr_valid$method[i]) &&
      !is.null(thr_valid$GMM2_means[[i]]) &&
      !any(is.na(thr_valid$GMM2_means[[i]])) &&
      !any(is.na(thr_valid$GMM2_sds[[i]])) &&
      !any(is.na(thr_valid$GMM2_weights[[i]]))
  }

  n_traces_per_method <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(thr_valid)), function(i) {
    if (is_gmm_valid(i)) 5L else 3L
  }, integer(1))

  n_base <- 2 + nrow(thr_valid)
  n_thr <- sum(n_traces_per_method)
  n_total <- n_base + n_thr
  trace_starts <- n_base + c(0, cumsum(head(n_traces_per_method, -1))) + 1

  fig <- plot_ly() |>
    add_bars(
      x = global_mids,
      y = global_counts,
      width = global_widths,
      marker = list(color = "black", line = list(color = "white", width = 0.5)),
      opacity = 0.7,
      name = paste0("Distribution (n=", nrow(df), ")"),
      hovertemplate = "avg=%{x:.3f}<br>(n=%{y})<extra></extra>"
    ) |>
    add_trace(
      x = df$x,
      y = rep(-max_global * 0.02, nrow(df)),
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "markers",
      marker = list(symbol = "line-ns-open", size = 8, color = "#00688b", opacity = 0.5),
      name = "Data rug",
      hoverinfo = "skip"
    )

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(thr_valid))) {
    y_seq <- seq(0, max_global * 1.05, length.out = 20)
    fig <- fig |>
      add_trace(
        x = rep(thr_valid$threshold[i], length(y_seq)),
        y = y_seq,
        type = "scatter",
        mode = "lines",
        line = list(color = method_colors[i], width = 1.5),
        name = thr_valid$method[i],
        hovertemplate = paste0(thr_valid$method[i], ": cutoff=%{x:.3f}<extra></extra>")
      )
  }

  visibility <- list(c(rep(TRUE, n_base), rep(FALSE, n_thr)))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(thr_valid))) {
    threshold <- thr_valid$threshold[i]
    flagged <- if (direction == "low") df$x < threshold else df$x > threshold
    ok <- df$x[!flagged]
    bad <- df$x[flagged]
    n_flag <- sum(flagged)
    pct_flag <- round(100 * n_flag / nrow(df), 1)

    local_breaks <- sort(unique(c(global_breaks, threshold)))
    local_mids <- head(local_breaks, -1) + diff(local_breaks) / 2
    local_widths <- diff(local_breaks)
    h_ok <- hist(ok, breaks = local_breaks, plot = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE)
    h_bad <- hist(bad, breaks = local_breaks, plot = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE)
    local_max <- max(h_ok$counts + h_bad$counts)

    bin_ids_bad <- vector("list", length(local_breaks) - 1)
    for (b in seq_along(bin_ids_bad)) {
      in_bin <- if (b == length(bin_ids_bad)) {
        df$x >= local_breaks[b] & df$x <= local_breaks[b + 1]
      } else {
        df$x >= local_breaks[b] & df$x < local_breaks[b + 1]
      }
      bin_ids_bad[[b]] <- paste(df$id[in_bin & flagged], collapse = "<br>")
    }

    y_seq <- seq(0, local_max * 1.05, length.out = 20)

    fig <- fig |>
      add_bars(
        x = local_mids,
        y = h_ok$counts,
        width = local_widths,
        marker = list(color = "#00cc66", line = list(color = "white", width = 0.5)),
        opacity = 0.8,
        name = paste0("Ok (n=", length(ok), ")"),
        hovertemplate = "avg=%{x:.3f}<br>(n=%{y})<extra></extra>",
        visible = FALSE
      ) |>
      add_bars(
        x = local_mids,
        y = h_bad$counts,
        width = local_widths,
        customdata = unlist(bin_ids_bad),
        marker = list(color = "#e13102", line = list(color = "white", width = 0.5)),
        opacity = 0.8,
        name = paste0("Flags (n=", n_flag, ", ", pct_flag, "%)"),
        hovertemplate = "avg=%{x:.3f} (n=%{y})<br>%{customdata}<extra></extra>",
        visible = FALSE
      ) |>
      add_trace(
        x = rep(threshold, length(y_seq)),
        y = y_seq,
        type = "scatter",
        mode = "lines",
        line = list(color = method_colors[i], width = 2, dash = "dash"),
        name = thr_valid$method[i],
        hovertemplate = "cutoff=%{x:.3f}<extra></extra>",
        visible = FALSE
      )

    if (is_gmm_valid(i)) {
      means <- thr_valid$GMM2_means[[i]]
      sds <- thr_valid$GMM2_sds[[i]]
      weights <- thr_valid$GMM2_weights[[i]]
      x_seq <- seq(min(df$x), max(df$x), length.out = 300)
      scaler <- nrow(df) * mean(diff(local_breaks))

      gmm_line_colors <- if (direction == "low") c("#a80000", "#107c10") else c("#107c10", "#a80000")
      gmm_fill_colors <- if (direction == "low") {
        c("rgba(168,0,0,0.25)", "rgba(16,124,16,0.25)")
      } else {
        c("rgba(16,124,16,0.25)", "rgba(168,0,0,0.25)")
      }

      for (k in 1:2) {
        density <- weights[k] * dnorm(x_seq, mean = means[k], sd = sds[k]) * scaler
        fig <- fig |>
          add_trace(
            x = x_seq,
            y = density,
            type = "scatter",
            mode = "lines",
            fill = "tozeroy",
            fillcolor = gmm_fill_colors[k],
            line = list(color = gmm_line_colors[k], width = 2),
            name = paste0(
              "GMM comp.", k,
              " (mu=", round(means[k], 3),
              ", sigma=", round(sds[k], 3), ")"
            ),
            hoverinfo = "skip",
            visible = FALSE
          )
      }
    }

    visible <- rep(FALSE, n_total)
    visible[2] <- TRUE
    start <- trace_starts[i]
    visible[start:(start + n_traces_per_method[i] - 1)] <- TRUE
    visibility[[i + 1]] <- visible
  }

  labels <- c("All thresholds", vapply(seq_len(nrow(thr_valid)), function(i) {
    threshold <- thr_valid$threshold[i]
    flagged <- if (direction == "low") df$x < threshold else df$x > threshold
    paste0(thr_valid$method[i], " (", round(100 * mean(flagged), 1), "% flagged)")
  }, character(1)))

  buttons <- lapply(seq_along(labels), function(i) {
    list(
      method = "update",
      args = list(list(visible = visibility[[i]])),
      label = labels[i]
    )
  })

  fig |>
    layout(
      title = list(text = paste0(metric_name, ": QC threshold explorer")),
      barmode = "stack",
      plot_bgcolor = "white",
      paper_bgcolor = "white",
      xaxis = list(title = metric_name, gridcolor = "#e5e5e5"),
      yaxis = list(title = "Count", gridcolor = "#e5e5e5"),
      legend = list(orientation = "v", x = 1.02, y = 1, xanchor = "left"),
      updatemenus = list(list(type = "dropdown", buttons = buttons, x = 0, y = 1.15))
    )
}
```

# metric explorers

```{r metric-explorers}
plots <- map(seq_len(nrow(metric_spec)), function(i) {
  spec <- metric_spec[i, ]
  thresholds <- threshold_results |>
    filter(metric == spec$metric)

  plot <- plot_thresholds_interactive(
    dataset = qc_metrics,
    metric = spec$metric,
    id_var = "code",
    df_thresholds = thresholds,
    direction = spec$direction,
    nbins = 80,
    metric_name = spec$label
  )

  saveWidget(
    plot,
    file.path(params$output_dir, paste0("thresholds_", spec$metric, ".html")),
    selfcontained = TRUE
  )

  plot
})

htmltools::tagList(plots)
```

# average thresholds

```{r average-thresholds}
average_thresholds <- threshold_results |>
  filter(!str_detect(method, "percentile"), is.finite(threshold)) |>
  group_by(metric, label, direction) |>
  summarise(avg_threshold = mean(threshold), .groups = "drop")

write_csv(
```

# metric distributions

```{r metric-distributions, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
qc_metrics |>
  select(all_of(metric_spec$metric)) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") |>
  left_join(average_thresholds |> select(metric, avg_threshold), by = "metric") |>
  left_join(metric_spec |> select(metric, label), by = "metric") |>
  filter(is.finite(value)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = value)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, color = "white", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_rug(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = avg_threshold), color = "red", linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~label, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "count")
```
